title: Doc2EDAG: An End-to-End Document-level Framework for Chinese Financial Event Extraction
language_domain_task: Chinese financial announcements; document event table extraction
design_implication: Cross-sentence arguments and multiple event records justify document context and separate claims.
transfer_limitations: Chinese/DS labels; no transferred English accuracy; no actual correction/followup policy derived from paper
reading_limitations: Read modelling/label unit sections only; not full-paper read

title: FinQA: A Dataset of Numerical Reasoning over Financial Data
language_domain_task: English financial report table/text QA and reasoning programs
design_implication: Evidence retrieval and calculation programs are separate; execution/program accuracy have distinct limits.
transfer_limitations: Simplifies complex tables; dataset/source report redistribution rights unverified; no event extraction benchmark
reading_limitations: No dataset downloaded; no model adopted

title: Inter-Coder Agreement for Computational Linguistics
design_rule: Independent labels; field denominators; ordinal/nominal separation
design_implication: Reliability is distinct from validity; disagreement distances and missingness affect coefficient choice.
transfer_limitations: No local human agreement measured; final coefficient not yet chosen
reading_limitations: Selected assumptions read; whole 42-page paper not read

title: IFRS Practice Statement 2: Making Materiality Judgements
design_rule: P02-004; accounting vs research action distinction
design_implication: Non-mandatory financial-reporting guidance; not a research action label or US rule.
transfer_limitations: Full standard paragraphs not read; no US-company legal materiality conclusion

title: Event Studies in Economics and Finance
read_sections_pages: Publisher URL returned no readable body
design_rule: Future method reading; outcome separated from assessment
design_implication: No methods adopted from unread body.
transfer_limitations: Estimation/event-window procedure not implemented; body access unresolved
reading_limitations: Bibliographic reference retained from REFERENCES, body unread

title: FinBERT: A Pretrained Language Model for Financial Communications
language_domain_task: English financial communications; financial sentiment classification

title: SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System Reference
design_implication: Labels, hierarchy and cross-scheme mapping have different semantics.

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
design_implication: Track source, extraction activity, authorship and revisions separately.

title: The Financial Industry Business Ontology
design_rule: Candidate term source only; no term adopted

read_sections_pages: Introduction; Exhibit 1 phases 1–6; public learning outcomes
design_implication: Analysis starts with purpose/questions and tracks follow-up.

title: Evaluating Quality of Financial Reports
language_domain_task: Financial reporting quality vs results quality
design_rule: Separate interpretation from raw facts and uncertainty
design_implication: Reporting quality and earnings/cash-flow quality are distinct analytical concepts.
